notes.title: 0.8.0.0 Update: absolutely tons of new stuff
notes.notes:
Alright, after some off time there to get everything more polished, im back with a huge new update!

(If you want to see raw patchnotes skip to bottom)

Firstly im introducing a new Gamemode, in this gamemode instead of building a fleet on the fly you can now create a fleet in the new skirmish area with a set amount of reasources and face off against a selection of 5 (for now) AI fleets built with the same amount.

Secondly oculus touch support has been added, including the ability to rotate yourself with the extra buttons and render models for the touch controllers.

Thirdly two new areas have been added, an encyclopedia area where you can get various stats about all of the vehicles available to you and the weapons attached to them. This is accompanied by a new tutorial area with a much greater write up about how to play the game.

And finally a ton of small changes towords polish listed below:

- oculus Touch A button rotates
- Oculus Touch Render Models added.
- Splashscreen not unity personal anymore
- Combat Polished (targeting improved).
- New Gamemode fleetmaker lobby added.
- Menu Area palate remixed
- Added new "Skirmish" Gamemode.
- Improved look of shielding effect.
- Healthbars added to enemy ships when you hover over them.
- Ships in formation now fly at the same speed.
- Victory gap improved.
- On Wrist Minimap.
- On Wrist Menu-Access.
- Improved Engine Trails
- Added Engine Trails to new ships.
- Fixed the lighting going dark on re-loading the main level.
- Stuff added in background to make maps look nicer.
- Added Seemless trainsition between levels
- Added Encyclopedia area.
- Added Range to ship Weapons
- Removed locked selection area bug.
- Added new Tutorial Area.
- Fixed Tutorial Missions.
- New font.
- Text no longer passes through objects
- Fixed Ships Spawning limits.

as usual, if you find any bugs give me a shout in the bugs threads and il see what i can do for getting them fixed!

notes.title: Content Update
notes.notes:
This Update contains a few new ships and some bugfixes.

Full Patch notes:

- Chaged around ship categories to "Frigate", "Cruiser" and "Support"

- Added Cruiser, expensive, slow, lots of guns.

- Added Healer Ship, heals surrounding ships.

- Added Light Destroyer, a cheap, multipurpose ship.

- Reworked Destroyer, its a bit weaker and more specialised now.

- Changed Ship model on Missile Ship, is weaker and more speciallised now.

All the new ships can be found in the spawn menu, the on ship menu is more of a quick menu for now.

- Temporary Ship movement indicator does not show with menu open

- Missiles now track correctly

- Tutorial Improved (only a bit)

- Initial scaling up works better.

Edit: Second hotfix up

- You now cant select unit with menu open.
- Added a check that should force the spawn menu to remain in the correct rotation.
- Fixed Light Destroyer Target Acquisition and, they actual fire in the right direction now too.
- CapitalShip has cannons now.
- CapitalShip colliders improved.
- Fixed that lag when explosions are first rendered.
- Fixed the ships exploading for the first time lag.
- Get map icons to display correctly.

Polish to do!

notes.title: Stability update + formations
notes.notes:
In this update i have stopped that occasional crash  (i think), added better formations control, totally re-written movement and collision avoidance systems (Works in 3d again!) and fixed an uncountable number of bugs.

Full patch notes below:
- Fix Campaign Assault
- New Collision avoidance system.
- Crashing fixed
- New Formations system. (More formations coming later)
- Controller Indicator for formations.
- a few small Optimisations
- Improve Brawler Damage.
- Improve LOD settings.
- (Fixed like 19 smaller bugs)
- Move Movement point to holographic movement pointer.
- Tutorial Updated
- Removed flickering

Edit:
Fixed issue where ships would occasionally go up, uncontrollably

Edit 2 small update to fix some light stuff: 
- Movement locks to sphere
- Grip button with hologram active disables it without spawning
- Force Field does not active upon controller entrance
- Description for holograms
- Line can be disabled in Menu Scenes
- Fixed Random Rotation

notes.title: 1st Weekly(ish) update: tons of new stuff
notes.notes:
Patch notes are as follows


-Ships now generate formation and retain the formation throughout the match.
-Timer in Defence Mission now Works
-Asteroids are now immpassable objects
-Sounds now travel to more accurate Distances
-Post Battle Victory/Defeat scene added(post game stats coming later)
-Controllers now have more interesting models
-CapitalShip Healthbar now works
-You can now deselect units by clicking the upper right corner of the touchpad.
-All ships Buffed to prolong engagements
-Collision Avoidance Improved
-Spawning System totally re-written, You now spawn ships physically with your hands (the menu is still on the bridge as well)  you now cycle through menus with the touchpad, and grab a ship with the grip button then pull the trigger to spawn it.
-Portals have been totally re-written, they now look much, much nicer.
-New Music, All levels now have a selection of 3 potential tracks to play, two of which have been made exclusively for the game.
-Scaling up mechanics, now is more "spectacular", pending further tweeking.
-Full Custom Game mechanics, instead of three difficulty selecitons, you now choose between 5 difficulties and 3 maps in a lobby. Its much cleaner.
-Difficulty mode count increased to 5.
-Ship Detail Increased.
-Tutorial Has been revereted back to text.

Shout me if you find any bugs, the demo patch should be out in a few hours :)

edit: second update pushed that fixes the main menu (oops)

edit: third update pushed that :
-victory and defeat scenes now work correctly
-tutorial camera fixed
-you now grab a hologram with the trigger instead of the grip
-you can now walk around with the menu open.
-map2 now works correctly

edit: Forth (and fifth, no more after this until Saturday or so) update: 
- Camera flickering Fixed
- Destinations change with map jump(fixed???)
- Camera ViewDistance Fixed
- Removed random ships from red map
- Pink lines removed
- Duplicate Settings manager removed
- You now Cant use horrizontal while menu open
- You now Cant grip move while scaled down
- Lazer toggle causing lighting changes fixed
- Improved performance by making the enemy capital movement system non-crashy
- Defence and assault correct way round
- Skirmish Menu works correctly
- Reduce timeskip to 2x
- Camera FarClip increased
- LOD system Improved


Edit: Soo, The Demo might have been broken for the last 2 weeks *facepalm*, either way, fixed now.
Slightly later Edit: aaand sales doubled instantly, im an idiot.

notes.title: Polishing Update
notes.notes:
Everything has been polished, de-bugged and improved. still stuff left to do but this will go along way to making the game feel (*more) complete (to clarify polished, not anywhere near feature complete yet).

-Friendly carriers now spawn bombers again.
-You no longer have all units de-select upon returning to capitalship.
-The unit cap has been increased
-Ships now collide properlly and dont clip through each other
-Ships get pushed by projectiles hitting them less 
-Missileship missiles now pass through the missileships so you can now fire at a 360 degree arc
-The Destroyer allied and enemy versions now fire at the same rate.
-The selection line is smaller and less cumbersome.
-The grip button now de-selects all units, to de-select individual units press the touchpad then press the grip button.
-Tutorial Updated
-Tooltips telling you what everything on the controllers does is now present in the tutorial.
-Dust is removed from the defence map.
-Level loading systems updated.
-Targeting and movement bugs have been "probably" fixed, i couldnt find a cause so i did aload of things that should stop any of the potential causes and it hasnt happened since so heyho.
-about 5 other bugs i forgot.

notes.title: 22nd October evening update
notes.notes:
I should really start numbering these

Patch notes:

-Got someone to make a nicer logo.

-Streamlined view controls (now you switch between drag and horizontal movement modes by pressing the menu button, while the grip button jumps you in and makes you leave the ship)

-The menu has been cut down significantly while keeping the functionality.

-The time scale settings can now be found on your wrist.

-The title can be skipped with the grip button.

-The pointer for the main menu is automatically brought up now.

-When ships are targeting an enemy ship the movement line is red. 

-You can now use the menu with ships selected and not have it order the ships to your position.

I tested this one a bit more so hopefully there will be less bugs, either way shout me if you find one.

notes.title: Huge Update
notes.notes:
Changed and fixed huge amounts of things over the last few days, a load of theM broke each other so i have had to compress everything into this update:

- levels have nebula (it looks cool but a bit strangly 2d, i may remove it if people dont like it)

- You can now drag the world around you

- text has been re-made so it doesnt jitter when moving

- The onship UI has been changed to a menu brought up by pressing the menu button on your right hand controller. 

- Trackpad movement is now faster

- rotation is no longer done by rotating the controllers relative to each other.

- Since vertical movement is now un-nessacary, you can now rotate by switching left controller modes.

- Re-wrote tutorial to account for the control changes 

- Added limits to scaling so you cant go so big or so small it crashes the game.

The update is already in the full game, i will be adding it to the demo in about half an hour.

If something doesnt work when you load up, put a thread about it in forums, i usually fix reproducable bugs within hours, im still working on controllers dissapearing and levels reseting. Thats next on schedule

enjoy :D.

notes.title: Massive Performance update
notes.notes:
This update fixed a number of issues:
- Ship types are now displayed above the ships when selected

- Ship health is now displayed when selected

- Changed how selected ships are highlighted 
http://imgur.com/FyFNd7B the old way looked better, but this way doesnt grind 
your rig to a halt with enough ships or if you looked at it the wrong way.

-Turned on Single pass stereo, its amazing how easy it is to miss these things.

To Conclude everything should now run 2 or more times better and i should be able to raise the unit cap.
